d.subject: Focus refinement: relative public-candidate liveness, not blind expiry
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
d.finding: Current discovery accepts public candidates with CONTINUOUS or ON_CHANGE reporting modes. Silence alone can therefore be legitimate at a stationary hinge. The selected gap is narrowed to candidate liveness under contradictory newer events from another registered public hinge source; a blind wall-clock public-angle expiry is not justified by current evidence.
d.unchangedCore: HingeAngleSource.choose() still has no per-candidate freshness and can keep a historically finer silent source selected while discarding a live fallback candidate.
d.en: Refinement: do not expire a public hinge source merely because time passed; on-change sensors may legitimately be quiet while stationary. The confirmed gap is relative failover when another registered sensor is actively reporting newer hinge evidence and the preferred source remains silent.
